about:
American Plastic Molds is a plastic injection molding business based in Pompano Beach, Florida. The locally established company has operated in the area for more than 50 years, serving customers across Broward, Palm Beach, and Miami‑Dade counties.

The shop provides plastic injection molding, mold production, part development, ultrasonic welding, mold maintenance and repair, and 3D printing. It handles projects from prototype through full‑scale production runs, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume are not disclosed.

The company produces plastic components for industrial, medical, construction, and automotive applications. Its customer base includes businesses throughout the South Florida tri‑county region.

American Plastic Molds emphasizes adopting new methods and technologies — such as ultrasonic welding, which creates molecular bonds without adhesives or solvents — to accommodate a wide range of orders efficiently and reduce manufacturing time.
